answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A juniper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the horizon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
